blocks.text: Grade 5 高频词汇 201–300
calendar /'kælində/ n. 日历, 日程表；v.t. 列入表中；[计] 日历
This means that every year, the solar and lunar calendars differ by about 11 days.
中文语境：这意味着每年阳历和阴历相差约11天
solar /'səulə/ adj. 太阳的, 日光的, 源自太阳的；[医] 太阳的; 腹腔丛的
It's simply that the Jewish calendar is based on a lunar year, which is shorter than a solar year.
中文语境：简单地说，犹太历是基于农历年，农历年比太阳年短
appreciate /ə'priːʃieit/ v.t. 赏识, 鉴别, 为...而感激, 领会, 欣赏；v.i. 增值, 涨价
Thanksgiving is a time to appreciate all that you have.
中文语境：感恩节是感激你所拥有的一切的时刻
eclipse /i'klips/ n. 日食, 月食, (地位名誉等的)消失；v.t. 引起日食, 引起月食, 使黯然失色
Just the day before, there had been an eclipse of the moon.
中文语境：就在前一天，发生了月食
customary /'kʌstəməri/ adj. 习惯的, 惯常的；[经] 通常的, 习惯的
It's customary for families and communities to light candles and clay lamps.
中文语境：家庭和社区有点燃蜡烛和粘土灯的习惯
religion /ri'lidʒən/ n. 宗教, 信仰；[法] 宗教, 宗教信仰, 信仰
Most people who celebrate Diwali are part of the Hindu religion.
中文语境：大多数庆祝排灯节的人都是印度教的一部分
inception /in'sepʃən/ n. 起初, 获得学位
At its inception, Kwanzaa was meant to lend validity to the Peace and Freedom, and Black Power Movements of the 1960's and early 1970's.
中文语境：宽扎节成立之初的目的是为 1960 年代和 1970 年代初的和平与自由以及黑人权力运动提供有效性
cuisine /kwiː'ziːn/ n. 烹调风格, 烹调法, 烹饪, 厨房

The festivities involve entertainment such as: traditional West African drumming and dance, song and poetry, West African cuisine, imaginative storytelling, performing arts, and an African marketplace.
中文语境：庆祝活动涉及娱乐活动，例如：传统的西非鼓乐和舞蹈、歌曲和诗歌、西非美食、富有想象力的故事讲述、表演艺术和非洲市场
reflective /ri'flektiv/ adj. 反射的, 反映的, 沉思的
These symbols represent values and concepts that are reflective of the African culture throughout the diaspora.
中文语境：这些符号代表了反映整个侨民非洲文化的价值观和概念
derive /di'raiv/ v.t. 得自；v.i. 起源
He derived the name from the Swahili phrase, "matunda ya kwanza," which means "first fruits of the harvest."
中文语境：他的名字来源于斯瓦希里语短语"matunda ya kwanza"，意思是"收获的初熟果实"
concur /kən'kəː/ v.i. 同意, 一致, 同时发生；[法] 同时发生, 并发, 同意
With one of these you concur, and I with the other." And Adams had agreed.
中文语境：你同意其中之一，我同意另一个。"亚当斯同意了
down /daun/ adj. 向下的；adv. 下, 下去, 降下；prep. 往下, 沿着；n. 丘陵, 软毛, 开阔的高地；[计] 向下, 退下命令
Two famous friends who had their ups and downs were John Adams and Thomas Jefferson.
中文语境：约翰·亚当斯和托马斯·杰斐逊是两位经历过坎坷的著名朋友
repeal /ri'piːl/ n. 废止, 撤消；v.t. 废止, 撤消, 放弃
And since he felt that Adams's appointment of judges was a personal attack, Jefferson had the new law repealed.
中文语境：由于杰斐逊认为亚当斯任命法官是人身攻击，因此废除了新法律
esteem /i'stiːm/ n. 尊敬, 尊重；v.t. 尊敬, 尊重, 认为
Jefferson's letters expressed his "sincere esteem and respect" for Adams.
中文语境：杰斐逊的信表达了他对亚当斯的"真诚的敬意和尊重"
architecture /'ɑːkitektʃə/ n. 建筑学, 建筑式样；[计] 体系结构
From then on, for fourteen years, the two old friends wrote back and forth, discussing natural science, history, architecture, religion, art, and agriculture.
中文语境：从此，十四年来，两位老友来回书信，讨论自然科学、历史、建筑、宗教、艺术、农业
bazaar /bə'zɑː/ n. 集市, 市场, 义卖市场
Taking the money, he hurried to the bazaar, and returned home laden with food.
中文语境：他拿着钱，匆匆赶到集市，满载食物回家
advisor /əd'vaizə/ n. 顾问, 劝告者, 指导教师
He gave the poor man riches beyond his dreams, and sent his foolish advisors away.
中文语境：他给了这个穷人超乎想象的财富，并打发了他愚蠢的谋士们
prophet /'prɒfit/ n. 预言者, 先知, 提倡者
"All my life," he told his courtiers, "I have heard tales of the wonderful Prophet Khizir, who drank the water of life thousands of years ago, and lives for ever.
中文语境："我一生，"他告诉他的朝臣们，"我听过伟大的先知希齐尔的故事，他在几千年前喝了生命之水，并且永远活着
razor /'reizə/ n. 剃刀；v.t. 剃
"Cut him up with a razor into little pieces.
中文语境："用剃刀把他切成小块
summon /'sʌmən/ v.t. 召唤, 召集, 号召, 振奋, 唤起, 鼓起；[经] 传唤, 传讯
"But, sire," his courtiers answered, "no one can summon the Prophet Khizir.
中文语境："但是，陛下，"他的朝臣们回答道，"没有人可以召唤先知赫齐尔
synchronous /'siŋkrənəs/ adj. 同时的, 同步的；[计] 同步
For many years, scientists thought synchronous fireflies could be found only in Asia.
中文语境：多年来，科学家认为同步萤火虫只能在亚洲发现
mite /mait/ n. 尽绵薄之力的捐献, 细微, 微少, 螨；[医] 螨
The woods are full of chiggers and mites and ticks.
中文语境：树林里到处都是恙螨、螨虫和蜱虫
amateur /'æmətə/ n. 业余爱好者, 外行, 爱好者；[电] 业余家
Amateurs changed his mind twice about a type of firefly behavior he studies.
中文语境：对于他研究的一种萤火虫行为，业余爱好者两次改变了主意
biology /bai'ɒlədʒi/ n. 生物学；[化] 生物; 生物学
Jonathan Copeland is a biology professor at Georgia Southern University.
中文语境：乔纳森·科普兰（Jonathan Copeland）是佐治亚南方大学的生物学教授
fright /frait/ n. 惊骇, 吃惊；[医] 惊吓
And the Noees all died of fright,
中文语境：诺伊人全都吓死了，
tambourine /.tæmbə'riːn/ n. 小手鼓
Trumpets and tambourines start playing, and all at once the dancers engage in a set of swirls and steps as they play their castanets.
中文语境：小号和手鼓开始演奏，舞者们在演奏响板时突然做出一系列的旋转和舞步
list /list/ n. 目录, 名单, 明细表, 布条, 条纹, 列表, 序列, 数据清单；v.t. 列出, 列于表上, 记入名单内, 装布条；v.i. 列于表上；[计] 列表, 序列, 数据清单
Children place their Cartas de Reyes, letters with wish lists for the Three Kings, in the baskets.
中文语境：孩子们将他们的"Cartas de Reyes"（写有三王愿望清单的信件）放在篮子里
joint /dʒɒint/ n. 连接处, 接合, 关节；adj. 共同的, 联合的, 连接的, 合办的；v.t. 连接, 接合, 使有接头；v.i. 贴合, 长节
You know your joints
中文语境：你了解你的关节
metal /'metəl/ n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料；adj. 金属制的；v.t. 以金属覆盖
Your body can be encased in metal, adorned with wheels,
中文语境：你的身体可以被金属包裹，装饰着轮子，
shaker /'ʃeikə/ n. 摇动者, 摇动器, 混和器；[计] 筛选
In Togo, people add a bell and a shaker to the drum family.
中文语境：在多哥，人们在鼓家族中添加了铃和振动器
keyboard /'kiːbɒːd/ n. 键盘；[计] 键盘
When an office worker types a letter, the clacking of the keyboard can become a performance.
中文语境：当办公室工作人员打字时，敲击键盘的声音可以成为一种表演
composition /kɒmpə'ziʃən/ n. 作文, 创作, 组成；[化] 成分; 组成
When the drum family works together combining its different sounds, it produces a composition more beautiful than any one instrument could produce alone.
中文语境：当鼓家族将不同的声音结合在一起时，它会产生比任何一种乐器单独产生的更美丽的作品
carpenter /'kɑːpintə/ n. 木匠
When a carpenter swings his hammer, he might swing the tool in a pattern that produces rhythm.
中文语境：当木匠挥动锤子时，他可能会以产生节奏的方式挥动工具
abstain /əb'stein/ v.i. 自制, 戒绝, 弃权, 回避
1 2 She not only abstained from beating him, but encouraged him.
中文语境：1 2 她不仅不再打他，还鼓励他
upbraid /ʌp'breid/ v.t. 谴责, 责骂, 申斥
Upbraid(verb)to criticize or scold harshly
中文语境：斥责（动词）严厉地批评或责骂
harshly /'hɑːʃli/ adv. 粗糙地, 粗暴地, 刺耳地
Upbraid(verb)to criticize or scold harshly
中文语境：斥责（动词）严厉地批评或责骂
rueful /'ruːful/ adj. 悲伤的, 后悔的, 可怜的
Akeisha gave a rueful laugh.
中文语境：阿凯莎遗憾地笑了
mote /məut/ n. 尘埃, 微粒
Tiny, glimmering motes sparkled just beneath her skin.
中文语境：微小的、闪闪发光的微粒在她的皮肤下闪闪发光
twig /twig/ n. 小枝, 细枝；v. 懂得, 了解
Shortly afterwards a birdcatcher came and stood under the tree, and laid his 2 "Ant" by Dino Quinzani is licensed under CC BY- lime-twigs for the Dove, which sat in the SA 2.0.
中文语境：不久之后，一名捕鸟者来到树下，将他的 2 只"蚂蚁"放在了树下，Dino Quinzani 的作品已获得 CC BY-lime-twigs 许可，用于位于 SA 2.0 中的鸽子
afterwards /'ɑːftəwədz/ adv. 然后, 后来
Shortly afterwards a birdcatcher came and stood under the tree, and laid his 2 "Ant" by Dino Quinzani is licensed under CC BY- lime-twigs for the Dove, which sat in the SA 2.0.
中文语境：不久之后，一名捕鸟者来到树下，将他的 2 只"蚂蚁"放在了树下，Dino Quinzani 的作品已获得 CC BY-lime-twigs 许可，用于位于 SA 2.0 中的鸽子
hull /hʌl/ n. 壳, 皮, 船体；v.t. 去壳
They could use the hulls for fertilizer.
中文语境：他们可以用壳做肥料
blackberry /'brækbəri/ n. 刺, 黑莓；[医] 黑果莓
Instead, he used blackberry juice.
中文语境：相反，他使用黑莓汁
paintbrush /'peintbrʌʃ/ n. 画笔, 漆刷；[计] 画笔
He used the hair from a horse's tail as his paintbrush.
中文语境：他用马尾毛作为画笔
soybean /'sɒibiːn/ n. 大豆；[化] 大豆
He also found new ways to use soybeans and sweet potatoes.
中文语境：他还发现了利用大豆和红薯的新方法
fertilizer /'fəːtilaizə/ n. 肥料, 促进发展者, 受精媒介物；[化] 肥料
They could use the hulls for fertilizer.
中文语境：他们可以用壳做肥料
enrich /in'ritʃ/ v.t. 使富足, 使肥沃
Peanuts would enrich the soil.
中文语境：花生可以肥沃土壤
greed /griːd/ n. 贪欲, 贪婪
...could give, he killed it and opened it only to find - nothing. "Golden Egg" by Mykl Roventine is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 2.0. 1 2 "GREED OFT O'ERREACHES ITSELF."
中文语境：...可以给，他杀死了它并打开它却发现 - 什么也没有。 Mykl Roventine 的"Golden Egg"已获得 CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 许可。 1 2 "贪婪会自我膨胀。"
delight /di'lait/ n. 高兴, 愉快；v.t. 使高兴, 乐于；v.i. 感到高兴(或愉快、快乐)
But he took it home on second thoughts, and soon found to his delight that it was an egg of pure gold.
中文语境：但他转念一想，把它带回家，很快他高兴地发现，这是一个纯金的鸡蛋
license /'laisns/ n. 执照, 许可证, 特许；v.t. 许可, 特许
"Golden Egg" by Mykl Roventine is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 2.0.
中文语境：Mykl Roventine 的"Golden Egg"已获得 CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 许可
occur /ə'kəː/ v.i. 发生, 被想到, 存在
Every morning the same thing occurred, and he soon became rich by selling his eggs.
中文语境：每天早上都会发生同样的事情，他很快就靠卖鸡蛋致富了
transit /'trænsit/ n. 经过, 通行, 运输, 运输线, 转变；v.t. 运送, 使通过, 经过；v.i. 通过
A trip that had taken months now took passengers a few days of comfortable transit.
中文语境：原本需要几个月的旅程现在让乘客们享受了几天的舒适过境
automobile /'ɒːtəməbiːl/ n. 汽车；[机] 汽车
It was small, about the size of an automobile, but it would be home for the whole family while they traveled to their new home.
中文语境：它很小，大约有一辆汽车那么大，但它是全家人前往新家时的家
persist /pə'sist/ v.i. 坚持, 固执, 持续, 坚称；[经] 持续
Then they would keep going, persisting whatever the weather, because they knew they had a long way to travel and could not delay long.
中文语境：然后他们就会继续前行，无论天气如何，都坚持下去，因为他们知道路途遥远，不能耽搁太久
obstacle /'ɒbstəkl/ n. 障碍, 妨害物, 阻碍
Obstacle(noun)something that blocks one's way or prevents progress 4.
中文语境：障碍（名词）阻碍某人前进或阻止前进的东西 4.
essential /i'senʃəl/ n. 要素, 要点, 本质；adj. 必要的, 重要的, 本质的；[计] 本质冒险
They would have to fit all they took in their wagon, so they would bring only the items that were essential.
中文语境：他们必须将所有携带的物品装进马车，因此他们只会携带必需品
paralyze /'pærəlaiz/ v.t. 使瘫痪, 使麻痹；[医] 使麻痹, 使瘫痪
In 1976, when he was a freshman in college, a skiing accident left Parks paralyzed from the waist down.
中文语境：1976年，帕克斯还是大学一年级新生，一次滑雪事故导致他腰部以下瘫痪
premonition /.priːmə'niʃən/ n. 预告, 预感, 征兆；[医] 先兆, 预兆
or a premonition.
中文语境：或者是一种预感
totter /'tɒtə/ v.i. 蹒跚, 动摇；n. 蹒跚的步子
Everything tottered from side to side.
中文语境：一切都摇摇欲坠
paltry /'pɒːltri/ adj. 不足取的, 琐碎的, 可鄙的
"Have you been such a fool, such a dolt, such an idiot, as to give away my Milky-White, the best milker in the parish, and prime beef to boot, for a set of paltry beans?
中文语境："你是不是太傻了，太傻了，太白痴了，竟然为了一套微不足道的豆子而放弃了我的乳白色奶牛，教区最好的挤奶工，还有优质牛肉？
reenact v.t. 重新制定, 再扮演；[法] 重新制定, 再用法律规定, 使再度生效
The search for Chu Yuan is reenacted by beating drums and racing dragon boats.
中文语境：以击鼓、赛龙舟的方式再现寻找楚原的情景
pupil /'pjuːpl/ n. 学生, 门生, 未成年人, 瞳孔；[医] 瞳孔
They chant prayers, light incense and firecrackers, clang gongs, beat drums, and paint the "dragon" pupils red or black.
中文语境：他们念经、烧香、放鞭炮、敲锣打鼓、把"龙"瞳涂成红色或黑色
neighboring /'neibəriŋ/ adj. 附近的, 邻近的, 邻接的
One day, Chu Yuan warned the emperor not to meet with the emperor of a neighboring kingdom.
中文语境：有一天，楚渊警告皇帝不要会见邻国的皇帝
mollusk /'mɔləsk/ n. 软体动物；[医] 软体动物
Stream foods include 'opae , the freshwater shrimp, and hihiwai (hee-HEE-vie), a mollusk.
中文语境：溪流食物包括"opae"（淡水虾）和 hihiwai (hee-HEE-vie)（一种软体动物）
scant /skænt/ adj. 不充分的, 不足的；v.t. 减少, 吝啬, 限制, 藐视, 忽略
This leaves scant water for growing taro.
中文语境：这样一来，种植芋头的水就所剩无几了
ounce /auns/ n. 盎司, 少量, 雪豹；[医] 英两, Г
Today, poi is sold in 1-pound bags or served at parties in 4-ounce containers.
中文语境：如今，poi 以 1 磅袋装出售，或以 4 盎司容器装在派对上
resort /ri'zɒːt/ n. 度假胜地, 手段, 凭借, 常去之地；v.i. 诉诸, 常去
Water from more than 90 percent of Hawaii's streams has been taken for sugar cane, housing, and resorts, leaving little to none in the streams.
中文语境：夏威夷超过 90% 的溪流中的水都被用来种植甘蔗、住房和度假村，溪流中几乎没有留下任何水
craven /'kreivən/ n. 懦夫, 怯懦者, 胆小鬼；adj. 怯懦的, 畏缩的, 胆小的
Courtney Craven, a non-binary gamer and disability activist in Chicago, runs the popular website Can I Play That?
中文语境：Courtney Craven 是芝加哥的一名非二元游戏玩家和残疾活动家，经营着热门网站 Can I Play That？
irrelevant /i'reləvənt/ adj. 不恰当的, 无关系的, 不相干的；[法] 无关的, 不相干的, 离题的
Honestly, I'd like my job to be made irrelevant.
中文语境：老实说，我希望我的工作变得无关紧要
deceit /di'siːt/ n. 欺骗, 谎言；[经] 诈骗, 欺骗
Those who seek to harm others often come to harm themselves through their own deceit.
中文语境：那些试图伤害他人的人往往会通过自己的欺骗来伤害自己
coax /kəuks/ v.t. 哄, 诱骗, 耐心地摆弄；v.i. 哄骗；[计] 同轴电缆
I can promise you a good time if you do." The Mouse did not need much coaxing, for he was very anxious to see the world and everything in it.
中文语境：如果你愿意的话，我可以保证你玩得很开心。"老鼠不需要太多的哄骗，因为他非常渴望看到这个世界和其中的一切
croak /krəuk/ n. 呱呱叫声, 哇哇声；v.i. 呱呱地叫, 发牢骚；v.t. 用嘶哑的声音说
When the Frog saw the Mouse, he swam to the bank and croaked: "Won't you pay me a visit?
中文语境：当青蛙看到老鼠时，他游到岸边，用沙哑的声音叫道："你不来看我吗？
treacherous /'tretʃərəs/ adj. 不可信任的, 危险的, 背叛的, 不可靠的；[法] 奸诈的, 背叛的, 背信弃义的
The Mouse soon had enough of it and wanted to return to shore; but the treacherous Frog had other plans.
